structure.unit: Professions and Occupations Regulated by the Department of Professional and Occupational Regulation and Boards Within the Department

law.catch_line: Auctioneers Board; membership, meetings and powers

text.section: The Auctioneers Board shall be composed of five members as follows: three shall be Virginia licensed auctioneers and two shall be citizen members. Board members shall serve four-year terms. The Board shall meet at least once each year for the purpose of transacting business. Special meetings of the Board may be held at the discretion of the Director.

The Board shall have the following authority and responsibilities:
Establish regulations to obtain and retain licensure of auctioneers.
Make all case decisions regarding eligibility for initial licensure and renewal thereof.
To fine, suspend, deny renewal or revoke for cause, as defined in regulation, any license.
To examine auctioneers for licensure.
